name: Ability Score Improvement
description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You can't raise a score above 20 with this feat.

choices.prompt: Increase one ability by 2, or two abilities by 1

name: Resilient
description: Increase one ability score by 1 (max 20) and gain proficiency in that ability's saving throws.

choices.prompt: Choose an ability: +1 and save proficiency

name: War Caster
description: Increase your spellcasting ability by 1 (max 20). You have Advantage on Constitution saves to maintain Concentration, can perform somatic components with weapons/shield in hand, and can cast a spell as an Opportunity Attack.

name: Great Weapon Master
description: When you score a Critical Hit or reduce a creature to 0 HP with a Heavy melee weapon, you can make one melee attack as a Bonus Action. Before a Heavy-weapon attack you can take a -? penalty for +PB damage. Also +1 Strength or Constitution.

name: Sharpshooter
description: Your ranged attacks ignore Long range penalties and half/three-quarters cover. Before a ranged weapon attack you can take a -? penalty for +PB damage. Also +1 Dexterity.

name: Mobile
description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet, difficult terrain doesn't cost extra movement when you Dash, and you don't provoke Opportunity Attacks from a creature you've made a melee attack against this turn.

name: Observant
description: Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom by 1 (max 20). You gain a +5 bonus to your Passive Perception and Passive Investigation, and you can read lips.
